analysis:
Examined the head_text of MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift lines 1013-1685 (media prep, deadline-checked stream, makeEventStream forwarding), the error enum patch and base/head text, and the ModelLoadAdmission doc-comment change. The scheduler patch excerpt is truncated, so only visible hunks were assessed.

Changed behavior: (1) GLM text path adds a withholding model: JSON response_format and forced tool calls are held until validated, via glmAnswer/GLM5NextResponseFormatOutput (lines 1231-1241, 1490-1493) and a GLM media rejection (patch around line 509). The withheld answer is emitted only after validation, which is fail-closed. Reasoning passes through the typed native channel. Withheld output is recorded via usageSignal.recordWithheldReasoning, preserving billing/usage accounting (relevant to A-001 and T-008). (2) A new typed unsupportedOutputControl error is mapped from the EngineV2Translation prefix to a 400 (MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngineError.swift 90-94, 145-146, 176-178). It is checked before the broader substring matches such as 'queue full' and 'token_budget_exhausted'. This reduces misclassification as a provider-reputation-striking 500, and the message is client-facing only (it carries no prompt content unless the bridge adds it, which is unverified). (3) ModelLoadAdmission change is comment-only.

No new trust boundary crossing, authorization, attestation, encryption or cache-storage behavior was found. Cache paths are unchanged: cacheEnabled:false for native media, and cacheScope is passed through unchanged (T-041 is not affected). The release/cancel paths on error are consistent: makeDeadlineCheckedEventStream cancels upstream and fires releaseBox, and the forwarding task fires releaseBox on every visible exit.

Remaining unverified items for integration: the truncated scheduler patch (lines ~985-1006, 1126, 1153, 1187) and the definitions of GLM5NextPromptPolicy.withholdsOutput, EngineV2Translation.unsupportedOutputControlPrefix and its emitter, and the status mapper in ProviderLoop. These were not supplied, so the 400 mapping and the GLM withholding semantics are only partially verified.
